A deer-like faun with long, flowing hair in a soft pastel pink shade that blends into a leafy mane. Large, gentle wide-set eyes in a glowing amber shade. Apparent age of a youthful adolescent. A lithe, quadrupedal body with slender legs and small cloven hooves. A natural palette of pale cream and soft green. Signature features include two small, budding antlers and a short, fluffy cream-colored tail. Four toes per hoof.
BODY COLOR: pale cream
